verdict.rationale: React documents running outside a browser: it can render on the server with Node (react-gh-2) and stream HTML (react-docs-6), which amounts to headless rendering. React Compiler also runs at build time and raises build-breaking errors (react-docs-15, react-docs-18), which suggests it fits into automated build pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI or headless automation workflows, guidance on headless testing or rendering for automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
